method: Unblinded manual review of immutable patch, delivery and command chronology; all booleans require evidence. Inspect public function signatures manually: structural type assignments do not exclude any or enforce exact parameter arity/order. Symbolic results are bounded to their supplied property/domain; unsupported syntax and absent usage are valid negatives, and no-counterexample claims must not be reported as project verification. Copy to source-review.json and fill, never infer task success from official completion alone.
